Boundaries.Name: yield
Boundaries.Boundary: yield requires a generator, which is refused first

Boundaries.Name: with
Boundaries.Boundary: loader rejects with in strict modules (TS1101)

Boundaries.Name: enum
Boundaries.Boundary: loader erasableSyntaxOnly rejects enum (TS1294) before lowering

Boundaries.Name: method-override
Boundaries.Boundary: checkOverrides also guards inheritance member kinds, accessor descriptors and ABI representation; not generated in this 0.1 corpus

Boundaries.Name: overloads
Boundaries.Boundary: implementation signatures are not lowered as overloads; needs a separate diagnostic design

Boundaries.Name: reopened
Boundaries.Boundary: throw Error/try/catch/finally, inheritance/super/abstract/protected, accessors, for-in on proven plain objects, RegExp/Set/JSON.stringify, Object helpers, arguments/files input opened after 0.1; not promised Refused by current compiler

Boundaries.Name: library-boundaries
Boundaries.Boundary: symbol/bigint/Date/process/globalThis/Intl and stdin/environment need individual loader/NotYet contracts; not generated

Boundaries.Name: polymorphic-recursion
Boundaries.Boundary: requires recursive generic instantiation; not generated

Boundaries.Name: module-boundaries
Boundaries.Boundary: namespace imports, export-star, default declarations and import cycles need multi-module probes; not generated
